newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: North Korean labourer defects to South Korea.
newsitem.headline: North Korean labourer defects to South Korea.

text.p: A North Korean worker who sought ayslum in South Korea has arrived in Seoul, the Agency for National Security Planning said on Saturday.
Kim Jeong-chul, 40, who was working in unnamed third country, landed at Seoul's Kimpo Airport on Friday.
An agency statment said it was questioning Kim on details of his identity and reason to defect.
More than 600 North Korean defectors now live in South Korea. Food shortages and economic collapse in the impoverished North has prompted a string of defections in recent months.
Hwang Jang-yop, who defected to South Korea last month, is the highest-ranked official ever to flee North Korea.
